content: Yauwe ina Tonuwalayao adi kwama kimaasabaidi adi gíluma

E Besaleli, Oliyavi be tokatanaki liliudi búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi, kwama kaausaraidi sigilumidi. Kwamayadi moe Yauwe ina Tonuwalayao adi kwama silosidi neta ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimaasabaina goi sipaaisewa. E nakae Eroni ana kwama sigilumidi. Ame kwamayadi sikimasabedi Yauwe ina paisewa manuna. Siguinuwa nakae Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
Tonúwala tolobona ana kwama ana gíluma

E tauyadi goura sikabi, sikaupapaeve ina aaa ikakaráiya. Ikavava, gourayana sitaseseli, e búyala simadagi. Ikavava, búyala buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi, búyala goura taiyao sinoepatukoidi. Ikavava, buyalayana be areko dedevina sikabidi, tolobo ana kwama sigilumi go, gilumayana ana kaigigita nakae gíluma ana tokatanaki idi paisewa.
Ikavava, aba latuba aiyuwo sigilumidi, e kwamayadi aiyuwo matakubudi goi sigilumipatukoidi.

Ikavava, kwamayana ana gigipáiwala sigilumidoko, ana kaigigita dedevina toina. Go gigipaiwalayana kwama goi sigilumipatuko. Ana búyala be ana kareko moe kwamayana nakae. Tauna sigilumi nakae sopagu goi Yauwe bogina ilovina siguinuwe.
E gurewa esaaesaidi anikisi madi kaba yata goura sikabidi, e gurewayadi goi Isileli natunao yoidi siginidi.
Ikavava, tolobona ana kwama ana kaba latuba goi siyatoidi. Gurewayadi moe Isileli tubunao adi kaba kinana bego Yauwe inuwokavatedi. Tauna siguinuwe nakae Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
Tonúwala kasikasina ana saisaira ana gíluma

E Tonúwala kasikasina ana saisaira sigilumi nakae tolobona ana kwama ana gíluma. Moe búyala noyanoyaidi goura, buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi be nakae areko dedevidi sikabidi, sigilumi. Tauyadi idi paisewayana nakae gíluma ana tokatanaki idi paisewa.
E tabodayana sinunumi, ana mamanao be ana papaeva sivavasa, moe nimakulemwasi aito.
Ikavava, saisairayana goi gurewa esaaesaidi túwana aivasi goi sikauvapotedi ame nakae: Túwana vakuumgoina goi gurewa yoidi rubi, topasi be beleli siyatoidi.
Túwana aiyuwoina goi gurewa yoidi turakoisi, sapaire be emeradi siyatoidi.
Túwana aitonina goi gurewa yoidi diyasinta, ágeta be ametísta siyatoidi.
Túwana aivasina goi gurewa yoidi kwatisi, anikisi be diyáspa siyatoidi. Ame gurewayadi adi kaba yata moe goura goi sikauvapotedi.
Gurewayadi tamo tamo goi Isileli natunao yawou aiyuwo yoidi tamo tamo siginidi. Tauna gurewa tayamo, you tayamo, gurewa tayamo, you tayamo. Youyadi Isileli tubunao adi dala yoidi.
E goura maavadaina sikabi, kasikasina ana saisaira ana seni nakae sinoedi.
Ikavava, rini madi kaba yata aiyuwo goura goi simadagidi. E kasikasina ana saisaira matakubuna aiyuwo diligaema goi sikauvapotedi.
Ikavava, seniyadi goura tayamo dadavina riniyadi goi sisikoidi
go, tayamo dadavina gurewa adi kaba yata aiyuwo goi sisikoidi. Aba yatayadi sikaiyaka tolobona ana kwama ana kaba latuba aiyuwo goi.
Ikavava, rini goura aiyuwo simadagidi, e kasikasina ana saisaira ogalaoina goi siyatoidi.
Ikavava, rini goura aiyuwo tuwaina simadagidi go, tolobona ana kwama ana sinapatúkwana goi siyatoidi. Go moe gigipáiwala dedevina diligaemaina goi be nakae kwamayana kukuna goi.

Ikavava, búyala buruu aiyuwo sikabidi, tayamo dadavina rini aiyuwo kasikasina ana saisaira ogalaoina goi sisikoidi go, tayamo dadavina rini aiyuwo tolobona ana kwama goi sisikoidi. Tauna kasikasina ana saisairayana ikaiyaka gigipáiwala dedevina diligaemaina, e geya itoboineyeta tolobona ana kwama goi italigalígava. E siguinuwa nakae Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
Tonúwala adi kwama tuwaina adi gíluma
E kwama tayamo maanawena sigilumi. Kwamayana madabokina buruu go, ikaiyaka tolobona ana kwama sinaena. Idi paisewa nakae togíluma dedevidi idi paisewa.
E kwamayana goi tapora tayamo Tonúwala nukotona manuna siwodugu. Taporayana kikina sikunupedoko, tauna geya itoboineyeta bei itaisa.
E búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi, mogolu keuwoina maisiyana sigilumidi, e kwamayana kikina ditonema dadavina goi sisikoidi.
E goura maavadaina sikabi, bere giyaidi simadagidi. Ikavava, kwamayana kikina ditonema dadavina goi sisikoidi mogolu nauyayanaidi.
Tauna bere tayamo mogolu tayamo, bere tayamo mogolu tayamo kwamayana kikina madabokina ivaníbita nakae. E siguinuwa nakae Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
E areko dedevidi toidi sikabidi, Eroni ma natunao adi kwama maanawedi sigilumidi.
Ikavava, e areko dedevidi tuwaina sikabidi, dábana aba vatúmna be ana pasapasa be nakae tarausisi aba saidibuna sigilumidi.
Ikavava, areko dedevidi be nakae búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi sikabidi, gigipáiwala sigilumi nakae Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
E goura maavadaina sikabi, dabayogigi simadagi senina maisiyana namliyeta sikimasabe Yauwe umana. E dabayogigiyana yatana goi sigini kadi, ‘Tauyana Kimaasabaina Yauwe Umana.’
Niga búyala buruu sikabi, dabayogigiyana sisiko dábana aba vatúmna nakae Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
Kaga liliuna simaadagidi simediMosese idovatusidi tetelina
E Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka, o tadigo kada, ‘Ina Kaba Valoboda’, madabokina ana madágina bogina ikavava. Isileli tubunao kaga liliuna simadagidi nakae boi Yauwe bogina ilovinaegu.
E Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyakayana konanina liliudi sikabidi, simedi yaigu. Konaninayadi ame nakae: Ana rini, ana vabodakalova, ana logógana, ana kówala madi kaba táoya.
Ana kaba vatumna sipi bolamo sakavaidi bogina kayakayaidi goi sikaredi, ana kaba vatumna ituli ta yoguyoguva sakavaidi be nakae ana vabodaupa kaarekoina.
Aba vatulúkwana dedeogaina mana kaitakeo be nakae aba núwala.
Teboroyana ma konanina be nakae beredi kimaasabaidi Yauwe umana.
E nakae ame konaninayadi simedi: Rampa adi kaba yata goura maavadaina mana rampa, konanina be nakae oribe mumuna rampa manudi.
Aba kasala goura, pútuma aba kaipaku, insensi mainina dedevina be nakae Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina.
Aba kasala kopwa ma vatalina, ana kaitakeo, konanina be nakae nokobaba kopwa ma kaena.

Ali ana kareko, ana kówala, adi kaba táoya be nakae ali ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina mana búyala be nakae ana kaba kokavata be nakae kónana liliudi aba paisewa Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyakayana sinaena manuna. Aba Kaiyakoyana moe ina Kaba Valoboda.

E nakae kwama dedevidi paisewa Bateta Kimaasabaina sinaena manuna simedi. Kwamayadi moe Eroni tauyana Tonúwala ana kwama Yauwe ina paisewa manuna be nakae natunao adi kwama, e bei tauyadi itoboinedi Tonúwala nakae sipaisewa.
E Isileli tubunao paisewa liliudi siguinuwedi nakae kaga liliuna Yauwe boi bogina ilovinaegu.
E kónana liliudi adovatusidi, e agitedi moitamo siguinuwedi nakae Yauwe iidigedi. Tuwo tomotayadi akaipakuyedi.
